description.from: Track Plexus-internal hardening of feedback evaluation preflight and integrity diagnostics. This epic contains no client-specific information.
description.to:
Purpose: Make every baseline, candidate, synthesis, and resumed evaluation comparison reproducible by preserving exact cohort identity, coverage, and provenance.

Exclusions:
- Changing feedback labels or client review policy.
- Replacing the canonical feedback evaluator.
- Silently substituting an unbalanced or independently selected cohort.

Dependencies: Supplies frozen cohort and provenance contracts to candidate safety, observability, and orchestration. Cohort work can proceed independently.

Definition of Done:
- Historical balancing considers every reachable output class and reports coverage.
- Recent and regression baseline cohorts are materialized or otherwise replayable with exact ordered membership.
- Fresh, candidate, synthesis, and resumed evaluations use the same applicable cohort.
- Missing provenance or replay failures fail closed.
- Explicit local dataset replay uses the canonical evaluation pipeline.
- Behavior-first specifications and focused tests pass.

Running log: Preserve existing issue histories and record sanitized decisions, attempts, outcomes, and next steps in this epic or its child issues.
